scene: You step from the wooden gondola into fragrant terraced tea gardens.
picture: Flat side view along a stone terrace. On the far left, a wicker garden gondola rests beside a steaming copper kettle on hot coals. The player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands left of centre. At centre stands a red tea pavilion. To the right are lush green tea bushes and stone steps.
shown: A round copper kettle hissing over glowing charcoal on the far left
An open red pavilion doorway hung with beaded curtains at the centre
A neat row of clipped tea bushes sprouting fresh tips on the right

variants.scene: Warm steam drifts from a kettle across the terraced hillside at sunset.
Lanterns glow softly around the pavilion as you search for {quest}.
Evening air smells sweet above the stone patio and lush green bushes.
